description: This source file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw project, specifically testing trust index resolution and skill bin path approval logic within the ExecSkillBinTrustTests struct. It provides test functions for building trust indices, verifying automatic approval of trusted skills, and rejecting duplicate skill bin paths with the same basename.

classes.name: ExecSkillBinTrustTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for validating trust index building and skill path approval logic.

methods.name: build trust index resolves skill bin paths
methods.description: Tests that the trust index correctly resolves and reports skill bin paths.

methods.name: skill auto allow accepts trusted resolved skill bin path
methods.description: Tests that the approval evaluator automatically allows trusted skill bin paths.

methods.name: skill auto allow rejects same basename at different path
methods.description: Ensures recognition and rejection of untrusted skill bins with identical basenames at different paths.

methods.name: makeExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified name for testing purposes.

methods.name: makeReport
methods.description: Generates a mock SkillsStatusReport object with specified skill bin names.
